rationale: The schema change widens the wire representation of speed_mps from float32 to float64 (proto3 float -> double). In Python, both protobuf float and double fields map to the built-in float type (IEEE 754 binary64). The generated bindings automatically handle the widened wire format; no source changes are required. The threshold 30.0 and observation key 'speed_mps' remain unchanged. Since the runtime already uses Python float for the field, the precision improvement is transparent and no explicit narrowing or conversion code exists to remove.
assumptions: The regenerated protobuf bindings (vehicle_pb2) will expose speed_mps as a float property, matching the new double wire type.
No external consumers depend on the previous float32 wire encoding; coordinated rollout is handled separately.
